name: brynvok-ollama
description: Local AI assistance backed by an Ollama server. No prompt or source code leaves the machine.

brynvok.ai.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Ollama server. Must be a loopback address unless `#brynvok.ai.allowNonLocalEndpoint#` is enabled.

brynvok.ai.allowNonLocalEndpoint.markdownDescription: Permit an endpoint outside this machine. Leaving this off guarantees that prompts and source code never reach the network.

brynvok.ai.requestTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a response before aborting the request.

brynvok.ai.chat.model.markdownDescription: Model used for chat. Must be pulled on the Ollama server beforehand, so the default is a small instruct model rather than a better but multi-gigabyte one. Larger models give noticeably better answers; switch at any time with **Brynvok AI: Select Chat Model**.

brynvok.ai.chat.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for chat replies. Lower values produce more deterministic answers.

brynvok.ai.chat.systemPrompt.default: You are a concise programming assistant. Prefer short, correct answers and complete code over explanation.
brynvok.ai.chat.systemPrompt.description: System prompt prepended to every chat session.

brynvok.ai.chat.historyLimit.description: Number of past messages sent as context. Older messages are dropped to bound the prompt size.

brynvok.ai.completion.model.markdownDescription: Model used for inline completions. This must be a base model that supports fill-in-the-middle; instruct-tuned models return prose instead of code.

brynvok.ai.completion.debounce.description: Milliseconds of typing pause before a completion is requested.

brynvok.ai.completion.maxTokens.description: Upper bound on tokens generated per inline completion.

brynvok.ai.completion.contextChars.description: Characters taken from before and after the cursor as fill-in-the-middle context.

brynvok.ai.completion.disabledLanguages.description: Language identifiers that never receive inline completions.
